metric: Pairs proved equivalent by the algebraic prover over every database meeting the declared NOT NULL columns and keys; pairs a database shows different (label failures) leave the denominator.
correctness: 0 false proofs: every proof's two queries return the same rows on the generated TPC-H or TPC-DS data and on 150 small random databases plus the targeted suite
caveats: Logos 333d5275ac87; query text fetched at run time, never committed. By family: rbot-tpch 19/21 proved, 1 refuted; rbot-dsb 19/36 proved, 1 refuted; tpcds-variants 4/12 proved, 2 refuted. 14 TPC-DS variant pairs are adapted (TOP n read as LIMIT n, date + n days as an interval): 4 proved, 2 refuted among them. TPC-H data is scale 0.1 (tpchgen-cli); TPC-DS data is scale 1 from DSB's dsdgen, whose distributions differ from the official kit's. The TPC-H schema declares no keys, so proofs hold over every database with its NOT NULL columns. Prover routes time out after 120 s of wall-clock time, so a loaded machine can turn a few proofs into timeouts. Baseline before any harness fix: 23/69 proved, 4 refuted, 0 wrong (5/11 held out). The two harness fixes (moving Calcite's derived-table column lists into the derived table with KumoSQL's expand_alias_columns, and one renamed TPC-DS column on the generated data) were made on the dev split, but the baseline listing showed every pair's failure reason, held-out ones included (tuned on test, exposure only; the held-out score did not move). Measured on 687c1d7. On 2026-11-11 rbot-dsb went from 17 to 19 proved with the rules written for QUITE's DSB development pairs (Kumo_SQL_Prover PR 19); an earlier whole run on the branch before main's later merges gave 45/69 (22 on rbot-dsb), and a run of main 0e94662 alone gave 39/69 against 41 on the earlier main, so the other batches' merges cost this eval proofs that the same branch had (the 2 timeouts, unknown and unsupported pairs moved; not diagnosed here). The rules were written on QUITE's pairs, not on these, but the LOGOS DSB queries are DSB templates, so rbot-dsb counts as tuned on test.
